question: In September 2025, in which district's Nandanagar block did sudden floods and landslides occur due to heavy rainfall, necessitating a large-scale NDRF/SDRF operation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chamoli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Nandnagar block**, which is the site of the flash floods and landslides, is situated in the **Chamoli district** of **Uttarakhand**.
 
• In **September 2025** (as per the question context), the region experienced **heavy precipitation**, resulting in the overflow of local rivers, specifically the **Pranmati River**, which caused sudden flooding in the area.
 
• The **National Disaster Response Force (NDRF)** and the **State Disaster Response Force (SDRF)** were mobilized immediately to carry out large-scale rescue operations and provide relief to the affected population.
 
• The disaster led to significant **landslides** that blocked major transport routes, including the **Nandnagar-Ghat motor road**, cutting off several villages from the district headquarters.
